policy: DCF uses equity free cash flow: statutory cash flow from operations minus gross tangible and intangible capital expenditure. Company-defined after-capex cash-flow measures are retained only as visibly labelled fallbacks. Equity FCF is not reduced by net debt again. EV/EBITDA uses reported EBITDA or EBITDA derived from official EBIT plus depreciation and amortisation; banks and holding companies show N/A.
